criticalities.label: Low
criticalities.description: Could be done without for weeks with little effect

criticalities.label: Moderate
criticalities.description: Its loss would be felt within days and worked around

criticalities.label: High
criticalities.description: Its loss would stop important work within a day or two

criticalities.label: Critical
criticalities.description: Research, care, or safety depends on it hour by hour

data_classes.label: Public
data_classes.description: Poses little or no risk if disclosed, and may be shared with anyone.

Research: Data already in a public repository
Business: Figures in a published annual report

data_classes.label: Internal
data_classes.description: Meant for the organization's own people and work. Not to be shared outside without a reason.

Research: Drafts and plans for future work
Health: Aggregate counts in which nobody can be identified

data_classes.label: Confidential
data_classes.description: Could harm people or the organization if seen by the wrong person, inside or out. Access is limited to those who need it.

Research: Data held under a data use agreement

data_classes.label: Restricted
data_classes.description: Governed by specific legal, regulatory, or contractual obligations. Loss or disclosure may require notifying people, partners, or authorities.

People: A name with a government identifier or full date of birth

owner_kinds.label: Owner
owner_kinds.description: Accountable for the record and for keeping it current

owner_kinds.label: Delegate
owner_kinds.description: Acts for the owner day to day

owner_kinds.label: Contact
owner_kinds.description: Knows the detail and can be asked

process_kinds.label: Administrative
process_kinds.description: Finance, people, legal, and the like

system_kinds.label: Application
system_kinds.description: Software people use to do their work

system_kinds.label: Platform
system_kinds.description: Something other systems are built or run on

system_kinds.label: Instrument
system_kinds.description: Laboratory or imaging equipment and its computer

system_kinds.label: Device
system_kinds.description: A medical, building, or other connected device

hosting.label: On premises
hosting.description: Run in the organization's own facilities

hosting.label: Cloud, run by us
hosting.description: In a cloud account the organization administers

hosting.label: Hosted by a supplier
hosting.description: Run entirely by a third party

hosting.label: Standalone
hosting.description: A single machine, often not on the network

lifecycles.label: Being retired
lifecycles.description: Still in use, with an end date

lifecycles.label: Unsupported
lifecycles.description: In use, and no longer maintained by its maker

third_party_kinds.label: Supplier
third_party_kinds.description: Sells goods the organization depends on

third_party_kinds.label: Service provider
third_party_kinds.description: Runs a service or a system for it

third_party_kinds.label: Subrecipient
third_party_kinds.description: Receives funds the organization passes through
